title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Factory on 1969-02-14
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > PCM (Sony HG tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic early‑1969 show highlighted by an intense Dark Star
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, noting that this recording shows the “seeds” of the famous Live Dead Dark Star and embodies classic ’69 Dead energy. The source is a soundboard tape with crisp, vivid detail, making the shimmering intensity of the band fully audible.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and imply high‑quality soundboard recording, giving a strong overall rating despite the limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers describe vivid intensity, suggesting clear, well‑balanced capture typical of soundboard sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑1969 set praised for its raw energy and cohesive flow, laying groundwork for later Live Dead versions.
